plan.title: Single-stage reverse auction with one required T&C

steps.note: Opens the single-stage event creation screen.
Enables eRFX event creation for the test company.
Allows the buyer to add the vendor during event creation.
Sets the single-stage event type to Auction.
Applies the available reverse auction template so the pricing sheet can be configured.
Adds the specified product with quantity 10.
Sets the requested delivery location on the first line.

args.goal: On the create screen, open Terms & Conditions, add the clauses "Payment within 45 days" and "Delivery within 7 days", set only "Payment within 45 days" to Required, leave "Delivery within 7 days" as None, click Done, and stop on the event create screen.

steps.note: Configures the event-wise terms with exactly one Required clause and one optional/None clause.
Adds one QA test vendor to the event.
Commits a Start now schedule with a 30-minute duration.
Confirms the event reached a published project page.
Moves to the invited vendor's separate supplier portal session.
Opens the event's pricing round in the vendor portal.

args.goal: In the vendor pricing screen, read the Terms & Conditions block, accept only the Required clause "Payment within 45 days", leave "Delivery within 7 days" visibly unaccepted, and stop with the bid form ready for submission.

steps.note: Checks the vendor can leave the optional clause unaccepted without treating it as mandatory.
Quotes 100 for the line and submits the bid after accepting only the Required clause.
Verifies that the vendor bid was accepted and the round is Submitted.
